description: The first MSPbots tool anywhere — readable filters, alias-named resources, full exports, and the KPI history MSPbots itself doesn't keep.

novel_features.name: Resource registry
novel_features.description: Name your bound datasets and widgets once, then use readable aliases everywhere instead of 19-digit resource IDs.

novel_features.name: Readable --where filters
novel_features.description: Write filters like "Update Date >= 2026-05-29" and the CLI compiles them into MSPbots' comma-encoded operator DSL.

novel_features.name: Timestamped snapshots
novel_features.description: Capture point-in-time copies of any dataset or widget into local SQLite — the history MSPbots doesn't keep.

novel_features.name: Auto-paginating export
novel_features.description: Dump an entire dataset or widget to CSV or JSONL, walking every page automatically.

novel_features.name: Numeric trend
novel_features.description: Time-series and point-over-point deltas for any numeric column across stored snapshots.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Row-level added/removed/changed comparison between two stored snapshots of the same resource.

novel_features.name: Inferred schema describe
novel_features.description: Sample live rows and infer the column names and types of a dataset or widget.
